summary: Upsnap is a lightweight dashboard application designed for sending Wake on LAN signals across a local network. It allows you to monitor the real-time operational status of your connected machines from a single web interface. The project is written in Go and distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits home lab administrators and network managers who need a straightforward visual interface to power on machines remotely without relying on command-line utilities.
watchOut: Wake on LAN functionality relies heavily on your local network configuration, and misconfigured broadcast packets or router settings can cause devices to fail to wake despite the application running correctly.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically runs via Docker with minimal resource overhead, though you will need to ensure the container has appropriate network access to send broadcast packets.
